description: Labeled Accounts. Calls only GET /v4/wallets/labeled-accounts and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching labeled wallets, programs and accounts. Filter by CEX, KOL, VC, entity name, or address with 10000+ labeled entities.

accountAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

entityId.description: Entity id to filter with (including as empty or null, such as "entity_id=" will filter programs without an entity_id)

entityName.description: Name of the business or entity that controls this account

labels.description: Category of account. Only accounts matching all labels will be returned (eg. labels=DEFI,NFT)

sortByAsc.description: Sort list ascending. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

sortByDesc.description: Sort by descending. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

name: list-labeled-accounts
title: Labeled Accounts
